text: Then Allah showed Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, the place of His House. And father and son began to build.
Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, laid the stones. Ismail, alayhis salaam, carried them. And as the walls of the Kaaba rose, they prayed:
"Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."
Our Lord, make us Muslims to You, and from our descendants a Muslim nation. Show us our rites, and accept our repentance.

And they asked for one more thing: our Lord, send among them a messenger from themselves, who will recite Your verses to them. Long after, Allah answered that dua: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.
Then Allah commanded: "Proclaim to the people the Hajj. They will come to you on foot, and on every lean camel, from every distant pass."
And they still come. Millions every year, just as Allah promised Ibrahim, alayhis salaam.
